title: POST /controls/{name} requires trade authority
statement: A read-only API key that also presents the correct OPERATOR_SECRET is refused with 403 on POST /controls/{name} before any setter runs; the route declares the same dependency gates as /risk-controls.
failure_mode: The control route only authenticated the key, so a read-only key holder with the operator secret could change live risk controls through the same setters /risk-controls protects.
